routes.name: web-search
routes.prompt:
Search the web to answer: {query}
Write to {out} in Markdown: a conclusion of at most 300 words, then one line per source: title - URL. Reply DONE when the file is written.

routes.name: youtube
eda-report
routes.prompt: Read {path}. It is an EDA tool report or log. Write to {out} in Markdown, at most 60 lines: the tool and stage; errors and warnings grouped by type, with counts; the worst violations (slack, path, endpoint); anything abnormal. Quote exact numbers. Reply DONE when the file is written.
